title: Right adjoint to derived direct image for qcqs morphisms
statement: Let X and Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, and let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism [def-pc-scheme]. The derived direct image Rf_* preserves D_{\mathrm{QCoh}} [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-category], and the restricted functor Rf_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y) has a right adjoint.

proof.text: Because f is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] says that Rf_* sends D_QCoh(O_X) into D_QCoh(O_Y), so the restricted functor in the statement is well defined.
The categories D_QCoh(O_X) and D_QCoh(O_Y) have all set-indexed direct sums by [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], applied separately to X and Y.
Since X is a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-compact-generation] gives compact generation of D_QCoh(O_X).
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism, [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-direct-sums] says that the restricted derived direct image Rf_* commutes with all set-indexed direct sums.

By the definitions of the derived category and total derived direct image [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the triangulated right-derived-functor statement [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], the restricted derived direct image is an exact functor between triangulated derived categories. Applying [lem-pc-brown-representability-right-adjoint] to the restricted functor, using Steps 2 and 3 for coproducts and compact generation and Step 4 for coproduct preservation, supplies a right adjoint.
